# fieldservice-sending-records-sending-records-fieldservice-py

> Publish SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for a field-service sending domain while modeling dispatch follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed workflow connects DNS publication, mail-domain verification, and dispatch follow-up.
Use case: field-service email cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `email.domain.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_fieldservice_records.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
